paper: A. Pontin, Q. Deplano, F. Marino and F. Marin, Optical squeezing mediated by levitated oscillators at their quantum ground state, Phys. Rev. A 114, 053704 (2026), doi:10.1103/hms3-yb2h
pdf_version: arXiv:2604.26790v1 (29 Apr 2026), the open-access copy returned for the DOI; figure numbering and content as in the PRA text
figure: Fig. 2 (four elements of the spectral covariance matrix), Fig. 3 (phase-frequency maps, raster), Fig. 4 (optimal quadrature spectrum)
method: Figs. 2 and 4: vector paths extracted with PyMuPDF (page.get_drawings) from pages 5 and 8; blue = measured (RGB 0.37, 0.51, 0.71), solid red = model with phase noise, dashed red = model without; paths clipped to each panel frame, axes calibrated by a linear fit to the grey gridlines (positions in PDF points listed per panel; tick values from the tick labels), then interpolated on a 0.5 kHz grid. Fig. 3 is an embedded JPEG (1190 x 503 px, page 7): the plot frames were found from the coloured area, the axes are taken as 70-160 kHz and -pi..pi rad (consistent with the tick labels 3, 0, -3 at 66.7 px/rad), and a pixel is counted sub-shot-noise when its blue channel exceeds red by more than 40 (the blue colour scale). The phase intervals are sampled every 1 kHz; the black contour lines inside the regions make the masks slightly ragged. Intervals closer than 0.07 rad (about 5 px, the width of a contour line) are merged.

text_values.eta: 0.32 (without the factor 1/2 of the heterodyne measurement)
